benchmark_type_evidence: we present Uhura—a new benchmark that focuses on two tasks in six typologically-diverse African languages, created via human translation of existing English benchmarks.
brief_description: Uhura is a benchmark for evaluating scientific question answering and truthfulness in six low-resource African languages (Amharic, Hausa, Northern Sotho, Swahili, Yoruba, Zulu), created via professional human translation of ARC-Easy and TruthfulQA from English.
